notes: Sporeling Mycelium Shield, 4x4: a brown basin holding a web of pale mycelium threads that run from a spotted mushroom cap in the middle out to eight blue-glowing nodes; light pulses outward along the threads on the 4-frame loop. Off: the web is dull and the nodes dark. Damaged: threads snapped, a node burst and oozing, the pulse stutters. Disabled: the web is withered and brown, the cap collapsed. COMPACT (tier 1-2 parts take less room inside): this inside half is the centre of the original art between its own edge columns, re-outlined (art/_src/compact.py).
